description: This file defines the SupplierScorecardPeriod class and related functions for managing supplier scorecard periods, including validation, calculation of criteria and scores, and mapping functions within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: SupplierScorecardPeriod
classes.description: A Document class representing a supplier scorecard period with methods for validation and score calculations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the scorecard period, including criteria weights and score calculations.

methods.name: validate_criteria_weights
methods.description: Ensures the total weight of criteria sums to 100%.

methods.name: calculate_variables
methods.description: Calculates variable values based on their paths or functions.

methods.name: calculate_criteria
methods.description: Calculates scores for each criterion based on formulas.

methods.name: calculate_score
methods.description: Calculates the total score based on criteria scores and weights.

methods.name: calculate_weighted_score
methods.description: Evaluates a weighted score using a provided formula.

methods.name: get_eval_statement
methods.description: Prepares an evaluable string from a formula by replacing variables with their values.
